item.description:
Kiku for Mac 1.0 (310): Kiku Account.
- New: Settings > Kiku Account. Sign in with an email code to sync your library through your Kiku account instead of iCloud, on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and the Kiku Chrome extension. - "Move library to Kiku account" copies your iCloud library (notes, PDFs, ink, folders, Up Next, reading positions and voice) into the account and verifies every file before switching. Your iCloud library is left untouched; "Use iCloud library" switches back at any time. - Narration progress now syncs between devices in account mode. - Includes everything in 309.
